actions.name: ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.delete
actions.description: Delete Assembly; remaining references refuse.

actions.name: ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.layers.add
actions.description: Add a Layer with one Layer-Segment of no Material. With no position it goes after the last Layer in the stored order; give index, or anchor_layer_id and side.

actions.name: ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.layers.remove
actions.description: Remove one Layer. An Assembly keeps at least one Layer.

actions.name: ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.layers.update
actions.description: Set one Layer's thickness.

actions.name: ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.layers.move
actions.description: Move one Layer one place outward or inward. A Layer already at that end stays.

actions.name: ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.layers.reorder
actions.description: Move one Layer to a position in the stored order, keeping the other Layers' relative order. Its current position changes nothing.

actions.name: ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.layers.flip
actions.description: Reverse the stored order of the Layers and keep the orientation, so the outside Layer becomes the inside one.

actions.name: ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.layers.flip_orientation
actions.description: Switch which end of the stored Layer order is the outside (first_layer_outside or last_layer_outside) and keep the order.

actions.name: ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.layers.set_air_barrier
actions.description: Mark one face of one Layer as the Assembly's air barrier, or clear it.

actions.name: ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.segments.add
actions.description: Add a Layer-Segment of no Material to one Layer. A membrane Layer holds one Layer-Segment.

actions.name: ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.segments.remove
actions.description: Remove one Layer-Segment. A Layer keeps at least one.

actions.name: ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.segments.update
actions.description: Set one Layer-Segment's width, continuous-insulation flag or steel stud spacing.

actions.name: ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.segments.set_material
actions.description: Set or clear one Layer-Segment's Material. A membrane Material needs a Layer of one Layer-Segment, and a membrane Layer thicker than 25 mm is reset to 1 mm.

actions.name: ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.segments.mirror
actions.description: Reverse the order of the Layer-Segments in every Layer of one Assembly.

actions.name: ph_composer.zones.retire_adjacency

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.update
actions.description: Edit guarded authored values of one Window Type.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.duplicate
actions.description: Duplicate a Window Type with independent identity.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.delete
actions.description: Delete Window Type; live references require replacement.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.grid.insert
actions.description: Insert a row or column band at a grid boundary, filled with new glazed elements. Elements spanning that boundary must be split first.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.grid.remove
actions.description: Remove one row or column band and the elements only it held. Refused while the layout carries installation assignments, and for the last band.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.grid.merge
actions.description: Merge two or more elements of one kind that cover one rectangle into a single element under a new id.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.grid.split
actions.description: Split one merged element back into one element per grid cell, each under a new id.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.grid.kind
actions.description: Make elements glazed or Empty. Empty is wall area: it clears the elements' Glazing, Frames, installs and operation.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.grid.flip
actions.description: Mirror the layout left to right, swapping left and right Frames, installs and operation directions.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.grid.dimension
actions.description: Set one row or column band's size.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.grid.paste
actions.description: Copy one glazed element's Glazing, Frames, operation and installs onto other glazed elements. Installs copy only where the edges match.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.grid.set_element_name
actions.description: Name one element.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.grid.set_element_glazing
actions.description: Set or clear one glazed element's Glazing.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.grid.set_element_frame
actions.description: Set or clear the Frame on one side of one glazed element; the other sides stay.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.grid.set_element_operation
actions.description: Set or clear how one glazed element opens. A fixed element has no directions.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.types.installs.save
actions.description: Assign Psi-Install Types to the edges of Window Type elements, in one Undo step, with any Psi-Install Types they need created, edited or copied from a library. Each listed element's four sides are replaced as given; null clears a side. A side may name a temporary client_id from psi_install_types.create or imports instead of a saved id. The panel's Installs session and the library assignment both use it; for one edge, list one Type with one element.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.units.remove
actions.description: Remove explicit Window occurrences with reference guards.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.units.rehost
actions.description: Glue an unmoved Window to an explicit same-storage Face.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.units.swap_type
actions.description: Swap explicit Windows, preserving their anchors.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.units.reset_to_type
actions.description: Reset explicit Windows of one Type to its authored geometry.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities
actions.description: Give the copies sharing each chosen Window's identity new identities. The first occurrence by entity path keeps the identity; a preview lists each old and new id.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.units.update_metadata
actions.description: Replace the user_data and installed extension payloads of explicit Window occurrences, guarded by the metadata last read.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.units.rename
actions.description: Set a Window's native instance name, the Instance field of Entity Info. An empty name clears it.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.units.new_flipped_type
actions.description: Create a horizontally flipped Type for one mirrored Window.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.units.restore
actions.description: Recover a Unit from exact stamped pane Faces.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.units.return_to_host
actions.description: Put a Window that has left its Face back on the nearest Face of its Zone. A Window still on its Face is left alone.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.units.place
actions.description: Place an anchored Window on an explicit writable Zone Face.

actions.name: ph_composer.windows.units.convert
actions.description: Replace reviewed drawn rectangles with placed Windows, one per group: a new Window Type sized from the geometry or a Type of that size. Sizes are the frame outer size.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.create
actions.description: Make one new Space with one Volume from a floor surface: explicit Faces loose in the open edit context, each becoming a Floor Segment. Works at the root, in a plain Group and in an open Zone, whose Space Group is placed outside the Zone at the same world position.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.volumes.create
actions.description: Group explicit loose Faces at an open Space's root into its next Volume.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.update
actions.description: Change one Space, Volume or Floor Segment's values, guarded by the values last read.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.batch_update
actions.description: Change many Spaces, Volumes and Floor Segments in one all-or-nothing step.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.volumes.remove
actions.description: Remove one Volume's structure: its Floor Segment records go and its Faces stay loose in the Space.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.delete
actions.description: Erase one Space and everything in it.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.remove
actions.description: Remove one Space and keep its floors: the records of the Space, its Volumes and their Floor Segments go, the Groups are exploded and the Faces stay where they are as plain geometry.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.update_metadata
actions.description: Replace the user_data and installed extension payloads of explicit Spaces, Volumes and Floor Segments, guarded by the metadata last read.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.make_independent
actions.description: Give the named copy of a Space, Volume or Floor Segment, and every record inside it, new ids in one step. The named occurrence is the one rewritten; a Space takes the next free number in its Zone.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.move_to_zone
actions.description: Host one Space in another Zone: its record names the Zone, and its Group stays where it stands. Ids, numbers and values are kept; any edit context may be open.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.unhost
actions.description: Take one Space out of its Zone, the repair for a Space whose Zone is gone. Its Group stays where it stands and its finding becomes space.outside_zone.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.floors.mark
actions.description: Mark explicit Faces directly inside Volumes as Floor Segments with one weighting factor; a marked Face takes the factor.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.floors.unmark
actions.description: Remove explicit Floor Segment records; the Faces stay.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.volumes.unprotect
actions.description: Unlock a protected Volume so context.open can open it. The edit context does not move; leaving the Volume later protects it again.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.volumes.restore_position
actions.description: Put a moved Volume back where it was last left, and protect it.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.settings.update
actions.description: Set the Model's last-entered height, guarded by the value last read.

actions.name: ph_composer.spaces.volumes.height_from_solid
actions.description: Set a Volume's average clear ceiling height from a closed solid: its volume over the Volume's net floor area. The solid is left as it was.

actions.name: ph_composer.thermal_bridges.types.create
actions.description: Create one Thermal Bridge Type. The group starts at 15-Ambient and the psi-value empty unless values give them.

actions.name: ph_composer.thermal_bridges.types.update
actions.description: Edit guarded values of one Thermal Bridge Type; a changed expected value refuses.

actions.name: ph_composer.thermal_bridges.types.duplicate
actions.description: Duplicate one Thermal Bridge Type with a new id and source derived.

actions.name: ph_composer.thermal_bridges.types.delete
actions.description: Delete one Thermal Bridge Type; a type still in use refuses unless a replacement, or null to clear, is given.

actions.name: ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.assign
actions.description: Assign one Thermal Bridge Type and quantity to explicit Edges, or reassign them; a stale or unwritable target refuses the whole command.

actions.name: ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.clear
actions.description: Remove the thermal bridge assignment from explicit Edges.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.context.open
view_commands.description: Open the Group or Component at the end of path as the edit context, through every one above it. Refuses a locked or missing step.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.context.root
view_commands.description: Close every open Group and Component, back to the Model's root.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.view.capture
view_commands.description: Write a PNG of the current view at the current camera and answer its path, hash and what it shows. Geometry only.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.colour_by.activate
view_commands.description: Turn one Colour-by mode on, or turn Colour-by off.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.colour_by.select_row
view_commands.description: Select and zoom to the entities one legend row stands for.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.colour_by.isolate
view_commands.description: Show one legend row on its own, or show every row again.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.colour_by.filter
view_commands.description: Colour only matching occurrence paths and mute the remaining geometry.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.colour_by.readout
view_commands.description: Show or hide one readout's viewport text, with any mode or none.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.zones.faces.open_attached_assignment
view_commands.description: Review a new Attached zone assignment for explicit Faces.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.zones.faces.close_attached_assignment
view_commands.description: Close the native assignment handoff.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.zones.faces.choose
view_commands.description: Set one Classify palette field and give the tool the viewport.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.zones.faces.stop_classifying
view_commands.description: Give the viewport back to whatever tool the user had.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.zones.faces.locate
view_commands.description: Bring an explicit set of Faces into view and outline them, leaving the selection alone.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.zones.faces.clear_locate
view_commands.description: Remove the outline the last Locate left in the viewport.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.zones.faces.select
view_commands.description: Select an explicit set of Faces and bring them into view.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.windows.convert_dialog.open
view_commands.description: Review which drawn rectangles Convert to Window Type would take and why it leaves each other Face out, for the panel to confirm.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.windows.convert_dialog.close
view_commands.description: Close the Convert to Window Type review.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.windows.place_tool.choose
view_commands.description: Choose a Type and anchor, then start Place.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.windows.place_tool.stop
view_commands.description: Stop Place and abandon its pending gesture.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.windows.units.locate
view_commands.description: Select and zoom to explicit Window occurrences.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.spaces.context.open
view_commands.description: Open a Space, or a Volume volumes.unprotect unlocked, as the edit context; a Volume being left is protected first.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.spaces.context.close
view_commands.description: Leave the innermost open Space or Volume for its parent, protecting a Volume being left.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.spaces.locate
view_commands.description: Select and frame one Space, Volume or Floor Segment. Nothing is unlocked: the path opens up to the first locked Group, such as a protected Volume, and that Group is selected instead.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.spaces.labels.set_options
view_commands.description: Show or hide the Space labels' optional lines for this Model session.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.spaces.mark_tool.start
view_commands.description: Give the viewport to the Mark floor tool with one weighting factor, and colour the Model by weighting factor.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.spaces.mark_tool.stop
view_commands.description: Give the viewport back to whatever tool the user had.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.spaces.create_review.open
view_commands.description: Review which explicit Faces Create Space would take into a new Space, why it leaves each other one out, and which Zone hosts it, for the panel to confirm.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.spaces.create_review.close
view_commands.description: Close the Create Space review.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.thermal_bridges.runs.locate
view_commands.description: Select the Edges of one run and bring them into view, opening the context that holds them.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edge_tool.choose
view_commands.description: Arm the edge tool with a Thermal Bridge Type and quantity and give it the viewport: each click or drag across Edges is one edges.assign.

view_commands.name: ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edge_tool.stop
view_commands.description: Give the viewport back to whatever tool the user had.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.library.providers.add_file
setup_commands.description: Add a library file the user chooses in a native picker to this machine's libraries.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.library.providers.add_folder
setup_commands.description: Add a folder of library files the user chooses in a native picker to this machine's libraries.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.library.providers.reset
setup_commands.description: Clear this machine's library setup when setup_state reports it unreadable. A readable setup is left unchanged.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.library.providers.remove
setup_commands.description: Remove a configured library from this machine.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.library.connections.connect
setup_commands.description: Start signing in to a hosted library.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.library.connections.reauthorize
setup_commands.description: Sign in to a hosted library again, keeping its connection.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.library.connections.disconnect
setup_commands.description: Sign out of a hosted library and clear what it loaded. Local copies stay.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.library.connections.settings
setup_commands.description: Open a hosted library's own settings.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.library.connections.remove
setup_commands.description: Disconnect a hosted library and erase its stored credential. Local copies stay.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.library.cancel_load
setup_commands.description: Cancel a hosted library load that is still running. The catalog it would have replaced stays as it was.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.library.load
setup_commands.description: Read a configured library into session memory.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.locations.approve_destination
setup_commands.description: Approve a save destination the user chooses in the native save dialog, so a caller with the export grant can export to it by location id until it is revoked.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.locations.approve_file
setup_commands.description: Approve a library file the user chooses in a native picker, so a caller with the setup grant can add it once by location id.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.locations.approve_folder
setup_commands.description: Approve a folder of library files the user chooses in a native picker, so a caller with the setup grant can add it once by location id.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.locations.revoke
setup_commands.description: Revoke an approved location. It stays refused as location.revoked.

setup_commands.name: ph_composer.locations.reset
setup_commands.description: Clear this machine's approved locations when list reports them unreadable. A readable store is left unchanged.

file_exports.name: ph_composer.library.export_file
file_exports.description: Write local definitions to a library file the user chooses in the native save dialog; export_preview shows what it will hold.

participants.name: ph_composer.library.copy_into_proposal
participants.description: Copy or reuse one library record, with optional assignment, inside the calling action's own proposal and Undo step.
